title: Exact Semiclassical Dynamics in a Multidimensional Quartic Potential: Multi-Flavor Instantons and Pre-Factor Dominance at Strong Coupling
summary: We present an exact semi-classical analysis of a coupled multi-degree-of-freedom quantum system governed by a symmetric quartic potential with four degenerate minima. Starting from the Euclidean path integral, we identify distinct paths that are longitudinal, transverse, and diagonal, each corresponding to distinct instanton configurations that mediate tunneling between vacua.
